first.rationale: Onboarding simplification directly addresses both declining completion and activation, with inherited evidence of durable activation lift and faster time-to-value. Promotional pricing could counter the competitor but has known retention harm, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a controlled shorter-onboarding experiment. The verified evidence directly addresses the 4% completion decline: shorter onboarding increased completion 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention 3%. Signup simplification also raised SMB activation 9% and qualified revenue 4%, though its -1% retention result and lack of replication beyond SMB warrant retention and qualified-revenue guardrails rather than a broad rollout. Promotional pricing is rejected because its known retention harm conflicts with sustainable long-term qualified revenue.
